sections.label: lag
sections.description: Macro-time lag dT at which the 2D fluorescence-decay correlation is built. Pick a value within the dynamics timescale to see lifetime cross-peaks.

sections.label: win
sections.description: Half-width of the macro-time lag window (ddT). Wider = more photon pairs but coarser lag resolution.

sections.label: tmin
sections.description: Lower micro-time gate (ns) for the decay axis.

sections.label: tmax
sections.description: Upper micro-time gate (ns) for the decay axis.

sections.label: bins
sections.description: Block-rebin the 2D-FDC down to this many bins before inversion (speed vs resolution).

sections.label: method
sections.description: Inverse-Laplace solver: Tikhonov (closed-form, fastest), NNLS (strict non-negativity, default), or maximum-entropy (faithful, slower).

sections.label: grid
sections.description: Number of log-spaced trial lifetimes in the inversion basis.

sections.label: τmin
sections.description: Smallest trial lifetime (ns).

sections.label: τmax
sections.description: Largest trial lifetime (ns).

sections.label: log λ
sections.description: Regularisation as log10(reg); 0 selects it automatically by L-curve.

sections.label: source
sections.description: How the IRF used for lifetime deconvolution is obtained. Synthetic = Gaussian pulse; Detect = place a synthetic pulse at the decay's prompt rise; File = IRF opened via 📈 Open IRF; None = tail-fit without an IRF.

sections.label: center
sections.description: Centre (prompt position) of the synthetic IRF in ns. Ignored for Detect/File/None.

sections.label: FWHM
sections.description: Full width at half maximum of the synthetic IRF (ns).

sections.label: skew
sections.description: Skewness of the synthetic IRF pulse (0 = symmetric Gaussian).

sections.label: rise
sections.description: When running the 1D-MEM, scan the IRF rise position and average the distributions around the optimum (port of TK_MyMain_Search_RiseIRF_1DMEM); reduces the IRF-timing systematic.

sections.label: corr
sections.description: After resolving the lifetimes, compute the species-resolved (lifetime-filtered) correlation and fit the interconversion relaxation time + rate matrix.

sections.label: cascades
sections.description: Multi-tau cascades for the filtered correlation.

sections.label: gMEM
sections.description: Build 2D-FDCs at several lags and jointly invert them with one shared lifetime distribution (global multi-lag 2D-MEM). Advanced; state separation is ill-conditioned for equal-brightness data.

sections.label: lags
sections.description: Number of macro-time lags for the global multi-lag MEM / kinetics scan.

sections.label: run
sections.description: Also build the 1D-FDC (zero-lag decay coincidence) and fit it with the explicit maximum-entropy method ported from the MATLAB toolbox, then decompose the distribution into Gaussian lifetime components.

sections.label: λ
sections.description: Initial MEM regulator (RegulatorConst). Larger = smoother; the schedule relaxes it over outer iterations.

sections.label: prior
sections.description: Entropy prior model (mi) ported from TK_mi_ModelFunction: 0 flat (resolution-weighted), 1 self (current dist.), 2 blend, 3 Gaussian.

sections.label: peaks
sections.description: Number of Gaussian lifetime components to fit to the MEM distribution.

sections.label: τ₁
sections.description: Fluorescence lifetime of state 1 (ns).

sections.label: τ₂
sections.description: Fluorescence lifetime of state 2 (ns).

sections.label: k₁₂
sections.description: Transition rate state 1 → 2 (1/s).

sections.label: k₂₁
sections.description: Transition rate state 2 → 1 (1/s).

sections.label: cps
sections.description: Per-state brightness in counts per second (equal for both states).

sections.label: time
sections.description: Acquisition time to simulate (s). Use the Sim button to generate and load the stream.

sections.title: 2D-FLCS map
sections.description: Inverted lifetime-lifetime distribution P (the 2D-FLCS map); its diagonal is the marginal lifetime spectrum, off-diagonals encode lifetime exchange.

sections.title: 2D residual
sections.description: Residual of the 2D inversion (data − model); should be structureless noise for a good fit.

sections.title: Lifetime distribution
sections.description: Resolved fluorescence-lifetime distribution; overlaid with the 1D-MEM and its Gaussian fit when enabled.

sections.title: Species correlation
sections.description: Lifetime-filtered species auto- and cross-correlations; their relaxation encodes the interconversion.

sections.title: L-curve
sections.description: Residual vs solution norm of the 1D lifetime inversion (log-log); the highlighted corner is the auto-selected regularization weight.

sections.title: IRF
sections.description: The active IRF (cyan) and the decay it deconvolves (yellow), both peak-normalized.
